critiques.primary_risk: Ag/Cu interface density may covary with Ag loading, particle size and exposed Cu surface area.
critiques.alternative_explanation: Changes in ethylene selectivity may originate from surface composition or catalyst restructuring rather than interface density alone.
critiques.discriminating_experiment: Compare catalysts at matched Ag fraction and electrochemical surface area while systematically varying interface length.
critiques.scientific_note: This is a predefined critical assessment, not an independently validated mechanistic finding or an LLM-generated conclusion.

critiques.scientific_note: This is a predefined critical assessment, not an independently validated mechanistic finding or an LLM-generated conclusion.

critiques.candidate_name: Ag nanoparticle distribution on Cu frameworks
critiques.primary_risk: The Cu-containing framework may reconstruct during electrochemical operation.
critiques.alternative_explanation: The active state may differ from the synthesized framework-nanosheet structure.
critiques.discriminating_experiment: Perform operando or post-reaction characterization and compare controlled Ag nanoparticle distributions.
critiques.scientific_note: This is a predefined critical assessment, not an independently validated mechanistic finding or an LLM-generated conclusion.
